Chapter 484: Chapter 19: The Strongest Life Form Since the Birth of the Spirit Realm (Please Subscribe)

Xianyao City, Lin Residence.

Lin Yuan and Lin Jianping, along with Shen Zhen, sat facing each other, eating spiritual dishes while chatting.

Over the past five hundred years, the fame of Martial Ancestor had spread across the three thousand Dao Provinces, even the strongest Immortal King from the Prehistoric Era, the Chaotic Celestial King, had voluntarily submitted to him.

However, very few knew about the parents of Martial Ancestor, which was also the result of Lin Yuan’s deliberate suppression.

His time residing in the Spirit Realm was limited, unable to protect Lin Jianping and Shen Zhen at all times, he could only try his best to detach them from the association with Martial Ancestor.

“Chang Er, try this spiritual dish…” Shen Zhen said with a smile, as Lin Jianping also expressed great interest.

...

The three of them finished eating.

After a moment of silence, Lin Yuan took the initiative to say, “I might not come back for a long time…”

With only a few more years left until his time limit, according to Lin Yuan’s plan, this was supposed to be his last meeting with Lin Jianping and Shen Zhen.

“A long time?”

Lin Jianping and Shen Zhen looked somewhat disappointed, but they had also expected this, as Lin Yuan was simply too dazzling, overseeing the three thousand Dao Provinces, hailed as the strongest in the era.

Such a great being surely had more important matters to attend to.

“Chang Er, go ahead and do what you need to do, we are very satisfied with our current lives,” Lin Jianping said.

Were it not for Lin Yuan, their Lin Family would still be a minor clan in Xianyao City, nowhere near their current exalted status.

“If you need help, seek Li Qing, she will arrange it well,” Lin Yuan nodded.

…

After leaving the Lin Residence.

Lin Yuan walked on the streets of Xianyao City.

In the past five hundred years, Xianyao City had already become the most prosperous center of Dongyun Tao Province,

The city, having undergone dozens of expansions, now covered an area of several million square miles,

Every day, numerous True Immortals and Half-Step Immortal Kings came in and out, and even the presence of Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings was felt.

The Martial Tao Cultivation System had spread across the three thousand Dao Provinces, in no way inferior to the Immortal Cultivation System,

In fact, in the several dozen Dao Provinces centered around Xianyao City, the Martial Tao Cultivation System even surpassed the Immortal Cultivation System.

It could be said that the prosperity of the Martial Tao Cultivation System had reached its pinnacle, not even those Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings or Supreme Immortal Kings dared to shake it.

“My current strength has already reached a certain limit…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

More than two hundred years ago, Lin Yuan had already thoroughly perfected the Fourth Stage of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

Since then, the Eighth Stage Chapter was pioneered, and as for the Ninth Rank Chapter… Lin Yuan also began to try integrating the Taiji Rule into the Space Rules, making some progress, with the integration currently at twenty to thirty percent.

In addition, Lin Yuan had already mastered over five thousand five hundred core space models in his comprehension of the fundamental Space Rules.

In five hundred years, Lin Yuan had comprehended over nine hundred core space models, a pace not comparable to the one thousand six hundred models understood in the previous three hundred years.

But it should be noted, out of seven thousand seven hundred eighty-two core space models, the difficulty of comprehension increases towards the later stages; many Evolvers at the peak of the Eighth Rank had been stuck on certain space models for thousands, if not tens of thousands of years.

In just five hundred years, Lin Yuan had almost effortlessly comprehended over nine hundred core space models, truly an abnormal and monstrous feat.

“Only over two thousand core space models left to completely master the Complete Space Rules…” Lin Yuan thought.

The Space Rules are a foundational rule of the Main World, and many Ninth Rank powerhouses have yet to master it; although in theory, the Eighth Rank has the potential to master the Complete Space Rules.

But that’s just theory.

In the long history of the Main World Universe Starry Sky, which Eighth Rank powerhouse has actualized this theory?

The breakthrough from Eighth Rank to Ninth Rank requires the Fusion Rules, but as a foundational rule, the Space Rules do not require full mastery for integration.

At the Eighth Rank, attempting to grasp the Space Rules or to discover more Cosmic Forces are both extremely time-consuming endeavors, arguably delaying the breakthrough to the Ninth Rank.

“With five thousand five hundred core Space Rules, enough to uphold an Inner World of seven hundred fifty thousand square miles, plus the thirteenfold base enhancement from absorbing the fluid in the Mysterious Gourd…”

“Now, the size of my Inner World has already surpassed nine million seven hundred fifty thousand square miles… approaching a billion square miles…”

The green fluid inside the Mysterious Gourd, being far more difficult to absorb than the previous three types, Lin Yuan had only managed to absorb nearly ninety-nine percent over five hundred years.

In theory, absorbing all four types of fluids in the Mysterious Gourd could enhance the Inner World by up to thirteen point three two times.

Now that Lin Yuan had already reached thirteen times, he wasn’t far from completely absorbing the green fluid.

“Power of Creation…” Lin Yuan thought of the greatest gain from this traversal.

The many gains before, for Lin Yuan, could be accomplished anywhere, not exclusive to the Spirit Realm.

However, the Power of Creation, only the Spirit Realm, with the easing of restrictions on such a Cosmic Force and the cooperation of various Celestial Kings, had Lin Yuan made astonishing progress in comprehending the Power of Creation.

So far, “I have mastered twelve kinds of superior Power of Creation and over sixty ordinary ones…”

In fact, in the last three to four hundred years, Lin Yuan had essentially given up on comprehending ordinary Power of Creation.

Since each superior Power of Creation encompassed the essence of multiple ordinary ones to some extent, comprehending a single type of superior Power of Creation was equivalent to understanding several, if not dozens, of ordinary ones.

“Twelve kinds of superior Power of Creation…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze grew fervent, his focus not on these twelve kinds of superior Power of Creation, but on feeling the strand of primordial essence of Power of Creation in his Inner World.
